name: Pearly White Spindle (Ioun Stone)
body:
Aura strong varied; CL 12th; Slot —; Price 20,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This stone grants the wearer the ability to regenerate 1 point of damage per 10 minutes. This regeneration works like a ring of regeneration. It only cures damage taken while the character is using the stone.

Cracked: Regenerate 1 hit point of damage per hour. Price: 3,400 gp.

Flawed: Regenerate 4 hit points of damage per hour. Price: 18,000 gp.

See Inferior Ioun Stones for details on cracked and flawed variant stones.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must be 12th level; Cost 10,000 gp
